reason: Slow months hurt me more than anything, and this sends jobs to my shop without a monthly fee, so I would sign up and take what comes in. I would not expect much until I see how many real requests reach a shop like mine in Riyadh.

would_change_my_mind: Proof that real booking requests for my kind of job actually reach shops like mine in my city, and a clear approval time.
